name: Md. Modabbir Hossain Mahin
title: AI Researcher & Aspiring Lecturer
bioLead: CSE graduate and AI researcher building explainable, privacy-preserving machine learning for healthcare. I am looking for a lecturer position where research supervision and teaching go together.
aboutParagraphs: I graduated in Computer Science and Engineering from State University of Bangladesh (2022 to 2026) with a CGPA of 4.00. My research focuses on explainable AI, federated learning and clinical decision support, with six papers presented or accepted at IEEE conferences.

I have tutored more than 100 SSC and HSC students since 2021 and lead 30+ members as President of the SUB Computing Club, where I organize workshops and mentor junior students on projects and research.
